Here’s the affiliate information for your Organna CBD Gummies brand:

Brand Introduction

Organna is a premium CBD brand dedicated to improving health and wellness through the power of nature. Our CBD gummies are crafted with high-quality, organically grown hemp to promote relaxation, better sleep, and overall balance. At Organna, we believe in making self-care delicious, effective, and accessible.

Product Description

Organna CBD Gummies offer a natural, tasty way to enjoy the benefits of CBD. Each gummy is infused with a precise dose of high-quality, broad-spectrum CBD, delivering powerful therapeutic benefits without any THC. Perfect for reducing stress, improving focus, relieving discomfort, and enhancing sleep quality, Organna CBD Gummies are ideal for anyone looking to boost their overall well-being.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

  • Premium Quality CBD: Sourced from organically grown hemp and tested for purity and potency.
  • THC-Free Formula: Experience the benefits of CBD without any psychoactive effects.
  • Delicious Taste: Naturally flavored gummies that make wellness enjoyable.
  • Holistic Benefits: Supports relaxation, better sleep, stress relief, and pain management.
  • Lab-Tested: Every batch is third-party lab-tested for safety, quality, and consistency.

Payment Terms

  • Trial Cost: Affiliates promote a trial offer at $4.90-$7 (shipping only), allowing customers to experience Organna CBD Gummies risk-free.
  • Commission: Affiliates earn generous commissions on each successful trial conversion, with additional rewards for repeat orders or subscriptions.
  • Payouts: Weekly payouts via PayPal, bank transfer, or other agreed-upon methods.

Other Information

  • Affiliate Support: Gain access to high-converting sales funnels, professionally designed marketing assets (social media graphics, banners, email templates), and a dedicated affiliate manager to support your efforts.
  • Trial Terms: Customers receive a 14-day trial to test Organna CBD Gummies before their subscription starts. They can cancel anytime during this period.
